conditions: the record is a file (the document to be tagged), not a folder or task
the file is the board pack draft
the file is located in the Launch folder
the file has an associated task that is a review task
that review task was created by Omar Haddad
that review task is about proofreading the launch summary
that review task has two assignees

turn2.differences: No material difference. Author's c1 groups file+PDF+board-pack-draft, c2 covers Launch-folder location, c3 groups review-type + created-by-Omar-Haddad + proofread-summary message + two-assignees. Together they cover the atomic conditions from Step 1.
turn2.naturalness_note: Real user would name the file (e.g. Board pack draft 1.pdf). Identifying it by task creator, task message, task type, and assignee count reads like constructed disambiguation among near-identical drafts.
